name: kitti_raw_2011_09_26_drive_0001
title: KITTI raw, drive 2011_09_26_0001: 108 Velodyne sweeps with the four camera streams
description: One synced+rectified KITTI raw drive read frame by frame out of the official 459 MB zip on S3 (HTTP Range: the central directory costs 157 KB, one sweep 2 MB). Velodyne sweeps are headerless float32 (N,4) x, y, z, reflectance in the sensor frame (x forward, y left, z up, metres) - the layout below is what makes them readable. Calibration files are their own samples.

license.note: KITTI terms: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0; the loader fetches from the authors' server, nothing is mirrored.

citation: Geiger A., Lenz P., Stiller C., Urtasun R. Vision meets Robotics: The KITTI Dataset. IJRR 2013.

lidar.description: Velodyne HDL-64E sweep, sensor frame (x forward, y left, z up)

calibration.description: KITTI calibration text files (velo_to_cam, cam_to_cam, imu_to_velo)
